  + $N =$ `r printsimlist$N `
  + $X \sim U(-1,1)$
  + Exposure: 
       
     - $\mathrm{logit}P(A|X)$ = `r sprintf("%s", printsimlist$a_present)`
     
  + Outcome:
  
     - $E(Y|X)$ = `r sprintf("%s", printsimlist$y_present)`
     
  + Censoring:
  
     - model: `r sprintf("P(C > t | X, A) %s",paste(as.character(printsimlist$c_form), collapse = " "))`
     - $\lambda_{C0}=$ `r printsimlist$c_basehaz`
     - $e^{\gamma_{C}}=$ `r sprintf("%s", printsimlist$c_present)` 
     
  + Death:
  
     - model: `r sprintf("P(T > t | X, A) %s",paste(as.character(printsimlist$d_form), collapse = " "))`
     - $\lambda_D=$ `r printsimlist$d_basehaz`
     - $e^{\gamma_D}=$ `r sprintf("%s", printsimlist$d_present)`
